Deep-diff these Boldteq Next.js marketing site pages against Webflow HTML. Output ONLY JSONL — one bug per line, no prose.

BASE PATH: /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq

## Pages to compare:

### Careers
- Webflow: boldteq-v1-0.webflow/careers.html
- Next.js: src/app/careers/page.tsx, src/components/careers/*.tsx

### Scope
- Webflow: boldteq-v1-0.webflow/scope.html
- Next.js: src/app/scope/page.tsx, src/components/scope/*.tsx, src/lib/constants/scope.ts

### Testimonials
- Webflow: boldteq-v1-0.webflow/testimonials.html
- Next.js: src/app/testimonials/page.tsx, src/components/testimonials/*.tsx, src/lib/constants/testimonials.ts

### Shared components
- Navbar: src/components/layout/navbar.tsx vs Webflow global nav
- Footer: src/components/layout/footer.tsx vs Webflow global footer
- BetaCTA: src/components/shared/beta-cta.tsx
- CTA Banner: src/components/shared/cta-banner.tsx (default title "Ready to Deliver This Level of Work Under Your Brand?")

## What to check:

### Careers
1. 4-step selection process: exact step titles + descriptions vs careers.html
2. 4 tabs exact labels: About Boldteq / Our Culture / Benefits / Career Opportunities — vs Webflow
3. 5 job listings: exact job titles + departments vs careers.html
4. 4 team testimonials: exact names + quotes vs careers.html
5. Benchmarks section: percentages + labels exact vs Webflow
6. "Global Impact" section: present + copy exact

### Scope
1. 4 platform tabs exact labels: "Shopify", "WordPress", "Shopify Apps", "Frontend Tasks" (or exact Webflow names)
2. 4 tier tabs per platform exact: "Small", "Medium", "Large", "Support" (or exact Webflow names)
3. For EACH of the 16 combinations (4×4) — spot-check 4-6 card bodies for exact copy vs scope.html
4. Scope hero heading exact vs Webflow

### Testimonials
1. Count testimonials in src/lib/constants/testimonials.ts vs testimonials.html
2. Each testimonial: exact quote + name + role + company — check first 5 for verbatim match

### Shared components
1. Navbar "View Full Service Scope" link → /scope present?
2. Footer 4 link columns: About / Services / Resources / Help — exact link labels
3. Footer Coming Soon badges on: UI/UX Design, Graphic Design, App Development, Affiliate — present?
4. Footer social links: LinkedIn + Instagram + Facebook — URLs correct?
5. BetaCTA: "15 agencies" urgency number exact? Left panel 4 checkmarks exact text?
6. CTA Banner default title exact match: "Ready to Deliver This Level of Work Under Your Brand?"

Output format (JSONL, one per line):
{"id":"CH-####","dimension":"D12|D13","severity":"P0|P1|P2|P3","route":"/careers|/scope|/testimonials|*","component":"src/...","line":N,"title":"...","evidence":"Webflow says 'X'; local says 'Y'","fix_hint":"...","estimated_minutes":N}

Read the Webflow HTML carefully. Only report real mismatches — exact text deviations. No false positives.
Pure JSONL. No prose.
